QuestInfo.name: [Sengoku Warriors] Dawn Comes Again
QuestInfo.0: The Oda forces have been driven out of Honnou-ji.
QuestInfo.1: The Oda forces have been driven out of Honnou-ji.
QuestInfo.2: The Oda forces were driven out of Honnou-ji. Although Princess Sakuno lost track of Nobunaga and the Four Heavenly Kings, the day was still hers. The Sengoku Warriors resolved to keep fighting.
